doc: Hardware engineering rules. Hardware geometry BELONGS to the hardware definition; the cabinet asks the hardware engine, it never hard-codes a drawer width.
source: GRASS Movement Systems 2026 (live) - Nova Pro Scala formulas
Hettich AvanTech YOU / Quadro / TopLine XL

drilling_distance.concept: TB = drilling distance from door edge, chosen from hinge overlay table
drilling_distance.note: Blum publishes per-overlay drilling-distance tables (front thickness vs overlay vs min gaps)

mounting_plates.note: Mounting plates sit on the 32mm System 32 grid (Blum 37/32 and 20/32)

applications.note: front covers a full 18mm side panel
two fronts share one side panel edge
front sits flush within the opening

hinge_systems.hinge_count_rule: more hinges for wider/heavier fronts (3 at KB>=1200 / weight>=12kg; 4 at KB>=1800 / >=20kg)

accessory_rules.front_support: for high fronts (H186/H250) up to 780mm front height

wood_drawer_concealed_runner.note: LMFKB3005A p60: open box, front+back+sides in 16mm PB + MDF/hardboard base, 12-13mm free space each side for runners, separate drawer front

types.AVENTOS_HKi: integrated stay lift (KH max 600, KB up to 1800, SWD 16-25)

lift_systems.software_lesson: mechanisms CONSUME internal cabinet space. Accessories are 3D collision objects, not labels.

space_tower_rule.note: Blum SPACE TOWER: shelf above eye level, drawers below; inner pull-outs at different heights by item height. Cabinet design is user-behaviour-driven.
space_tower_rule.future_model: StorageObject { height, width, depth, weight, frequency_of_use } -> propose storage positions

sliding_wardrobe_doors.topline_xl_capability: 18-30mm doors up to 60 kg with defined door-width constraints
sliding_wardrobe_doors.paix_note: PAX sliding doors sold in PAIRS, metal frame + panels, size = total two-door measurement, soft-closing
